ashwick_tack_room_dead.name: The Drowned Ferrymen
ashwick_tack_room_dead.intro: (ORIGINAL PLACEHOLDER ENCOUNTER) The two drowned ferrymen come forward with the patience of the river. Their coats are still buttoned.

victory_effects.text: (ORIGINAL PLACEHOLDER) The last drowned ferryman folds into the mud. In his fist is a bronze token stamped with an oar.

ashwick_bell_answer.name: The Answer at the Landing
ashwick_bell_answer.intro: (ORIGINAL PLACEHOLDER ENCOUNTER) The second note draws something up the landing stones: a drowned thing with a ferryman's coat and a mouth full of river mud.

victory_effects.text: (ORIGINAL PLACEHOLDER) The answer comes apart on the stones. The token is gone. Maela is waiting at the landing. Speak with her before you call the crossing finished.
